record.notes: Made under article 58 of the Malta Digital Innovation Authority Act and published in Government Gazette Supplement No. 21,519 of 10 October 2025. Regulation 1(3) deferred regulations 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 and 10 (fundamental-rights authorities, documentation, language requirements, high-risk registration, sandbox, complaints) to 2 August 2026; the designations and penalty provisions are not deferred. The Minister may designate further market surveillance authorities by order in the Gazette. Penalties on a public authority or body are capped at EUR 50,000 per infringement plus EUR 50 a day; proceedings are time-barred two years after the alleged infringement, and MDIA decisions can be appealed under Part IX of the MDIA Act. Regulation 12 adds the regulations, as S.L. 591.05, to the Second Schedule to the Administrative Justice Act. Legal Notice 227 of 2025, in the same Gazette, makes the Information and Data Protection Commissioner the market surveillance authority for high-risk systems used in law enforcement, biometrics, migration, justice and democratic processes.

verification.note: Stored and read in this run: the legal notice as published (legislation.mt PDF, 8 pages), which gives the Gazette supplement and date, the title, the enabling power, the commencement rule in regulation 1(3) and regulations 2 to 12; the legislation.mt ELI page, stored again on 17 October 2026 (its legal content is unchanged; only the site's list of latest updates differs), which gives the Gazette number and date; and the file legislation.mt serves as the Maltese-language version, which has the same SHA-256 as the English PDF, so the legal notice exists in English only (the ELI page's metadata titles the Maltese expression '(English Version only)'). The ELI metadata also gives 10 October 2025 as the first date of entry into force. The Commission's list of market surveillance authorities cited in version 1 is not stored, and its mention was removed.

judgment.status_reasoning: Published on 10 October 2025. Regulation 1(3) defers only regulations 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 and 10, to 2 August 2026; the others carry no commencement date, so they took effect on publication (the ELI page's metadata also gives 10 October 2025 as first date of entry into force). 2 August 2026 has passed (today 17 October 2026), so the whole instrument is in force: 'In force', with date_in_force 2025-10-10 and the deferred commencement in the notes.
